testsuite.name: UC9 Prescriptions
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system. The HCP must have begun documenting an office visit.

step.actions: hcp: The HCP selects the name of the prescription from a list. There is no option to enter names not tracked by the system.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM displays a success message and logs transaction
